test_cases.name: empty_input_asks_for_source
assertions: Asks the user for the idea, ticket, or alert because the User Input is empty
Does NOT create any file under docs/physarum/intents/
Does NOT invent an idea to write about

test_cases.name: invokes_writing_intent_skill
test_cases.input: /intent khách hàng muốn xem lịch sử đơn hàng theo tháng
assertions: Invokes the writing-intent skill, or reads .agents/skills/agentic-os/writing-intent/SKILL.md when the runtime cannot find it
Treats the User Input as source material for the intent
Does NOT put the procedure of writing an intent into its own steps

test_cases.name: classifies_source_asks_once_if_unclear
test_cases.input: /intent giảm thời gian load báo cáo
assertions: Classifies the source as idea, ticket, or alert
Asks once about the source type when it is unclear
Does NOT ask the source question more than once

test_cases.name: ticket_keeps_id_in_source_ref
test_cases.input: /intent CC-1234 Báo cáo doanh thu tải chậm hơn 10 giây
assertions: Sets Source: ticket
Writes CC-1234 into Source ref of the intent file

test_cases.name: tiny_change_says_not_needed_and_stops
test_cases.input: /intent đổi tên biến userCnt thành userCount trong một file
assertions: Says an intent is not needed for a Tiny/Quick change unless the user wants it recorded
Names the lane [/intent →] /implement → /verify → /ship
Does NOT write an intent file when the user did not ask to record it
Stops after naming the lane

test_cases.name: tiny_change_user_wants_record
test_cases.input: /intent đổi tên biến userCnt thành userCount trong một file, tôi muốn ghi lại intent
assertions: Writes a short intent with one line per section
Names /implement as the next command
Does NOT route the change through /spec or /plan

test_cases.name: hotfix_says_no_intent_and_stops
test_cases.input: /intent alert: production checkout trả 500 từ 10 phút trước, cần khôi phục như cũ
assertions: Says intent.md is not needed for a hotfix
Names /debug → /verify → /ship
Does NOT create an intent file
Ends the turn after naming the hotfix lane, with no analyst questions asked

test_cases.name: alert_needing_new_behavior_writes_intent
test_cases.input: /intent alert: nhiều user bị lock tài khoản, cần thêm cơ chế unlock qua email và đổi auth flow
assertions: Does NOT treat the alert as a hotfix because new behavior and an auth change are required
Writes a new intent file instead of stopping at the hotfix lane

test_cases.name: asks_questions_one_at_a_time
test_cases.input: /intent cho phép khách tự đổi địa chỉ giao hàng
assertions: Asks analyst questions one at a time, never as a batch list
Continues until every Classification predicate is answered or parked in Open questions

test_cases.name: writes_file_with_template_and_draft_status
test_cases.input: /intent cho phép khách tự đổi địa chỉ giao hàng (đã trả lời đủ câu hỏi)
assertions: Writes docs/physarum/intents/YYYY-MM-DD-<outcome-slug>-intent.md
File contains ## Classification and Status: draft
Slug comes from the outcome, NOT from the task name

test_cases.name: stops_with_class_lane_next_command
test_cases.input: /intent cho phép khách tự đổi địa chỉ giao hàng (file đã ghi xong)
assertions: Hands the file path to the originator for correction
States the proposed Class, the Lane, and the next command (first step of the Lane) in one line
Does NOT commit
Does NOT invoke brainstorming or writing-plans
Does NOT design
